# doocs/md theme assets

`default.css` and `simple.css` are copied without modification from
[doocs/md](https://github.com/doocs/md), commit
`07f4830918f2250a5565275dae1caefbb8b27392`, under the accompanying
WTFPL version 2 license. The production renderer uses these CSS assets with
compatibility substitutions for fixed colors and dimensions, and adds a small
set of platform-specific rules. Markdown parsing and CSS inlining use separate
libraries; this does not embed the doocs/md editor or renderer.
